Intel (INTC) annual revenue fell 33.1% in 4 years ($79.0B → $52.9B). The numbers show the size of the change, not its cause.

SEC financial snapshot · FY2025 (ended Dec 27, 2025)
• Revenue: $52.9B (−0.5% YoY)
• Operating margin: −4.2%
• Free cash flow: −$4.9B (−9.4% of revenue)

Latest quarter (ended Sep 26, 2026, 10-Q)
• Revenue: $16.5B (+20.9% vs the same quarter a year earlier)
• Operating margin: 15.3%

4-year view (FY2021 → FY2025)
• Revenue: $79.0B → $52.9B
• Operating margin: 24.6% → −4.2%

These are historical financial observations. They do not by themselves establish the drivers of growth, a research thesis or fair value.

Source: Intel Form 10-K for FY2025, filed with the SEC on Jan 23, 2026. Reconcile figures to this filing.
